circuit.notes: Heuristic v1 floorplan: 32x24 mesh @ 0.532 mm pitch, PHY strip + IO ring.

tiles.notes:
Tensor-core-style weight-stationary systolic array for large-matrix
LLM inference: 64 MAC lanes per cell give 128 INT8 ops per cell per
clock (vs 2 for a single-MAC cell).

blocks.name: pe_int8
blocks.notes:
INT8 PE @ N7 with per-PE register state rolled in. ~20K
transistors per PE (datacenter PEs carry larger weight buffers
than edge SKUs).

blocks.name: pe_matrix
blocks.notes:
Systolic Matrix cell: 64 MAC lanes (8-bit multiplier + 32-bit
accumulator + registers, ~4.7K transistors each) plus weight
registers and input forwarding. ~300K transistors per cell. L1 and
L2 are the tile's own local_memory, not in this block.

blocks.name: l1_sram
blocks.notes: Fabric-edge stream storage, per compute tile

blocks.name: noc_routers
blocks.notes: 32-byte flit routers with deep buffers for datacenter NoC

blocks.name: memory_phys
blocks.notes: HBM3 PHY is heavy -- ~200 Mtx per controller, dominates analog area

blocks.name: io_pads
blocks.notes: PCIe Gen5 x16 + power management + sideband

input.name: Stillwater KPU-T768
input.notes:
Datacenter-class KPU SKU for AI inference at scale. 768 heterogeneous
tiles in a 32x24 grid; INT8/BF16 tiles use 16x8 PE arrays while Matrix
tiles are 8x8 systolic arrays (tensor-core-style) for LLM inference.
192 MiB distributed L3 scratchpad. HBM3 64 GB / 1.6 TB/s. TSMC N7
process. Profiles 30W / 60W (default) / 100W, which compute 21.1 / 41.5 / 68.3 W;
the 100W profile is specified with liquid cooling.

Matrix tiles are systolic (graphs#268 D8): 8192 INT8 ops/clock from 64
cells of 64 MAC lanes each, stated on the tile rather than implied by a
PE-array throughput figure.
